Rules: Consonant to consonant is okay in first name
Consonant to vowel is okay in first name and surname
Vowel to vowel is prohibited
If skipping middlefix and combining consonant and vowel, ensure there are two consonants (adding an additional copy of the consonant if necessary) before the vowel
50% chance to skip middlefix in First Name
25% chance to skip Suffix in First Name (if no Middlefix)
25% chance to skip Middlefix in Surname
If consonant to consonant would occur in surname, drop a consonant at random to make it consonant-to-vowel
Avoid repeating the same letter in both in the first name and last name. If this would happen, replace with a random letter of the same type (consonant=consonant, vowel=vowel)
Treat y as a vowel
When two or more consonants differing from each other would connect, put an apostrophe (') between them
After finishing the surname, 5% chance to continue it with an additional roll, combining 2 Surnames together instead of 1.
For each vowel, 5% chance to replace that vowel with the next or previous consonant appearing in the name.
If vowels would ever connect, drop one of the vowels at random.
Prioritize the letters D and Z. If a name does not include one of these letters, 50% chance to replace a random consonant in the name with one of those letters.
If 'i' appears by itself surrounded by consonants, add an additional i (so riz becomes riiz).
If i is preceded by any of the following letters, add 'h' after that letter before the i: B, D, F, J, L, M, N P, V, X (so 'Miin' becomes 'Mhiin'
If a name does not contain the vowel 'i', 50% chance to replace an instance of a vowel surrounded by consonants with two 'ii's.
Treat 'Middlefixes' as a 'Suffix'. If you roll a 'Middlefix' successfully, then do not roll a Suffix for that part of the name. Middlefixes still have the same chance of appearing, though.
Additional +25% chance to skip a middlefix on the first name.
Weighing +25% on suffixes ending in a vowel.
Each time a vowel appears in the name, 25% chance to replace that vowel with the letter 'r' or, if the vowel is next to the letter 'r', drop that vowel entirely.
If the letter i appears surrounded by consonants, 50% chance to turn 'i' into 'ii'.
After choosing a Surname middlefix, 50% chance to add 'i' to the end instead of choosing a Surname suffix.
Chance of a first name Middlefix is 5%.
Chance of a first name Suffix is 25%, or 5% if a Middlefix was chosen.
If a first name only has a Prefix and it ends in a consonant, add a copy of that consonant to the end of the name.
If a first name only has a Prefix and it ends in a vowel, add a random Surname Middlefix to the end of the first name.

50% chance that, if a Middlefix for a surname is added, the middlefix will be from another random region. If so, Capitalize that Middlefix and precede it with an apostrophe ('), unless an Apostrophe already exists preceding it. That Middlefix must start with a consonant and must have at least 3 letters.
Vowels cannot repeat in the First Name nor the Surname (separately)
The longer the suffix, the higher its probability.
Do not connect two of the same vowel.
15% chance to start with a Middlefix instead of a Prefix (capitalize it if so).
Do not connect two of the same vowel.
GLOBAL RULES
Three vowels cannot be connected (Except Copari, Cyfrolaef)
Three consonants cannot be connected (except Kathaya, Cyfrolaef)
Names cannot exceed 64 characters total; if they would, reroll the name.
After a first name is generated, it must be rerolled the next time it is rolled. After that, the next time it is rolled, it can be kept.
Prefix odds: 100%
Middlefix Odds: 25% (First Name), 50% (Surname)
Suffix Odds: 75% (First Name), 60% (Surname)
